nodes.title: Foot stack, fin step and sizes (landing.py geometry())
nodes.equation: x_g = c + foot ; flange = x_g - pad - t_fl ; rim end = flange - stroke ; tine open = rim end - engage ; back wall = open - stroke - 1 mm ; L_cart = flange - back wall ; sections: cartridge + 2 cf -> tine + 2 w -> sleeve + 2 cs + 2 w ; sleeve roof = z_outer - lip, floor = roof - sleeve z ; fin step z = floor - glue, x = back wall - glue ; z_eff = z_outer - r ; TE clear = foot - stroke

nodes.title: Constant-force crush, biased cartridges (type U upper, type L lower)
nodes.equation: A_U = fy fz ; A_L = A_U - pi d^2/4 ; F_U,L = sigma A ; F_mean = (F_U + F_L)/2 ; bias = F_U / F_mean ; level: 4 F_mean (s - eps_y L/2) = m v^2/2 + (1 - lam) m g s ; n = 4 k F_mean / (m g) ; usable = s_max - guard >= C5 pair-first stroke ; normal set = (m v_n^2/2 - 4 F_mean eps_e L/2) / (4 F_mean) ; no-set sink = sqrt(2 E_el / m) ; strain = (pre + s_max) / (L + pre) (pre-crush counted) ; mark margin = s_max - guard - mark - s_pair ; landings = mark / set ; mean error = F_mean / F_C5 - 1

nodes.title: Narrow-axis tip-over about the pad edges, z_cg subtracted (CR-C5-01)

nodes.title: Cartridge crush coupon, both types
nodes.procedure: Pre-crush every segment 1 mm (drill-press stop). Crush 3 type-U and 3 type-L cartridge pairs in a printed piston + shoe on the drill press over the H1 load cell, 40 mm at < 10 mm/s; record force every 2 mm. Pass (C5-R3, mean force 5-35 mm): U 38.2-40.2 N, L 34.6-36.3 N, ratio U/L 1.09-1.14, peak <= 1.05 x plateau, flat to 40 mm. Off target: change section_y_m (both types) by the force ratio, or the bore tube (ratio), and re-run feet_calc.py.

nodes.title: Pad slide on a tilt board
nodes.procedure: Foot with pad, 0.65 kg on it, on a board faced with concrete paver / asphalt shingle / the landing mat; tilt until it slides; mu = tan(angle). Pass >= 0.7 dry.

nodes.title: Timed foot-insert swap
nodes.procedure: One student, field kit only, swap a crushed insert for a spare on the built aircraft; pass <= 10 min.

nodes.title: Shoe bond and flange proof load
nodes.procedure: Shoe bonded (24 h) on a stepped two-layer foam-board offcut with strip ends; load the pad along x to 88 N through a 10 mm steel block at the pad edge; hold 3 s. Pass: no bond crack, no flange crack.

nodes.title: Side load at the pad
nodes.procedure: Same specimen, insert pushed 4 mm in; 35 N at the pad sideways along y, then along z; pass: no crack at the rim or tine, insert still slides.
